depthInterpretation: Authored dominant conditional ray-mode hypothesis. Select the strongest prior mode per image component and assign its complete projected weight there. Not a recovered gas depth; no duplicated secondary-mode feature or artificial bridge. Two-scale variant: smoothed image light is carried along the simulation's own density (envelope); finite components fit only the remaining detail. This variant fits the calibrated DSS2 FITS composite (exact WCS, full dynamic range) instead of the 8-bit outreach JPEG.
